source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independent random country selection chose China. I compared a frontal throne portrait with a doorway pause and chose the latter for an inhabited court moment, legible sleeve/folding mass, and a reason for the document. Late Qing is agent-selected staging, with contemporary reference hair retained explicitly; the image is a costume reconstruction rather than historical documentary evidence. The viewer should feel poised anticipation and subtle personal appeal. Setting, costume details and hand action remain agent-owned and may be refined locally at creativity 1.
subject: A woman in a reconstructed Chinese palace court costume photograph, using supplied face and hair appearance.
setting: A staged late Qing palace corridor with a half-open vermilion doorway.
event: A paused court portrait at the threshold while holding a document folio.
visual_priorities: Reference facial proportions and short dark bob remain identifiable in the three-quarter portrait.
The robe silhouette, hands and document form one coherent waiting pose.
The open doorway, repeated red frames and daylight strip give the pause a spatial cause.
baseline_prompt_en: A palace court costume photograph of a woman portrayed as the portrait subject in a still moment in a palace court. Build a contemporary staged reconstruction of a late Qing Chinese palace corridor: she has reached a half-open vermilion doorway and is waiting to enter, her body facing the opening while her face turns gently back toward the camera. Use the supplied photograph as the face-and-hair appearance reference, preserving its facial proportions, dark eyes, short glossy dark bob and fine separated fringe. Her clothing and the palace are newly staged for this photograph. A long patterned silk court robe falls in a single vertical mass, its sleeves broad enough to produce a weighty fold at each wrist. She holds one closed rectangular silk document folio horizontally at her waist, both palms supporting its underside, elbows comfortably bent with each hand emerging from its own sleeve. The visible folio and her pause at the open threshold suggest an interrupted audience rather than a costume display. Her composed mouth and attentive eyes create a quiet personal presence, while a soft gleam on the cheek and silk supports a subtle, intimate attraction. Deep red door frames repeat behind her and converge toward the dim hall; a strip of cool courtyard daylight crosses the threshold and the front edge of her robe. Frame from head to just below the knees with the face, both hands and the whole folio readable together, an eye-level three-quarter view with natural perspective. Keep the near sleeve folds and skin texture tactile, the far corridor gently softened, and the costume's form clear enough to inspect. Photograph the real-looking set with restrained warm reds, deep blue-green silk and cool natural light.
